title: Grateful Dead Live at Allegheny College on 1971-04-15
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC (secure) > CD Wave > shntool > SHN v3 (seekable)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an intimate, high‑energy ’71 Allegheny College show with Garcia shredding and several standout jams.
ai_review.review: The recording is a superb soundboard source that presents the band in crystal‑clear form despite a few missing songs.  The performance is electric – the boys are smoking on classics like Bertha, Deal, Big Boss Man, El Paso and Good Lovin’, with Garcia delivering razor‑sharp solos and a powerful Pigpen‑led vibe throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.6, overwhelmingly positive comments on both show energy and soundboard quality; only a single low‑star outlier does not shift the overall assessment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, superb mix with clear instrument separation.  Reviewers note a few missing songs and one comment about a slightly veiled sound, but overall the audio is considered top‑notch.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Intimate small gym setting with the crowd close to the band; the show builds after Pigpen’s Good Lovin’, delivering an upbeat, trippy flow that keeps momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is praised for shredding, powerful tone and lightning‑fast solos on several numbers (Bertha, Deal).
